description: You are debugging a simple configuration management simulation. There are three directories that each represent a node in a distributed system: /home/user/node1, /home/user/node2, and /home/user/node3. Each node directory contains a file named config.txt with a single-line key-value pair in the format setting=value. A configuration manager utility tracks changed configurations by comparing the current state of all nodes and writing a log of detected changes. Your task is to: 1. Update the value of the key setting in /home/user/node1/config.txt to "alpha", in /home/user/node2/config.txt to "beta", and ensure that /home/user/node3/config.txt remains with the value "gamma". 2. Run a configuration check by comparing all three config.txt files to determine which nodes have values for "setting" that do not match each other. 3. Write the results into a log file named /home/user/config_changes.log with the following precise format: - Each line should state whether the configuration on each node matches or differs compared to the other nodes, in the format: [nodeX] setting: value - MATCH or [nodeX] setting: value - DIFF - Output all three nodes, one per line, in node1, node2, node3 order. For example, if all three nodes differ, each should have DIFF. If any match, multiple nodes may have MATCH. Make sure the file /home/user/config_changes.log is created with exactly three lines in this format, reflecting the up-to-date contents of the config files.
truth: Pre-task state: - Directories /home/user/node1, /home/user/node2, and /home/user/node3 exist. - Each contains a file named config.txt. - Initial contents (before task): - /home/user/node1/config.txt: setting=old1 - /home/user/node2/config.txt: setting=old2 - /home/user/node3/config.txt: setting=gamma Post-task ground truth: Final config.txt contents: - /home/user/node1/config.txt: setting=alpha - /home/user/node2/config.txt: setting=beta - /home/user/node3/config.txt: setting=gamma The required log file /home/user/config_changes.log must contain exactly: [node1] setting: alpha - DIFF [node2] setting: beta - DIFF [node3] setting: gamma - DIFF Each line must be separated by a single newline character (UNIX format), and no extra whitespace. Permissions: - All directories and files are owned by user and writable.
